scripts.build: echo Use: 'npm run build-win' on Windows machines and 'npm run build-lin' on Linux machines
scripts.build-win: vite build && copy .\src\manifest.json .\dist\manifest.json && copy .\src\contentScript.js .\dist\contentScript.js && copy .\src\spotifyInterceptor.js .\dist\spotifyInterceptor.js && copy .\src\pageInterceptor.js .\dist\pageInterceptor.js
scripts.build-lin: vite build && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/contentScript.js dist/contentScript.js && cp src/spotifyInterceptor.js dist/spotifyInterceptor.js && cp src/pageInterceptor.js dist/pageInterceptor.js
